name: hcportal_sendEventMessage
description: Posts a message to a run's chat from the portal and returns the push audience. Inserts into HC.EventMessage (optionally a photo/location kind, optionally quoting a message of the same run), then returns the message details and two FCM token lists — visible push and silent (badge-only) push — built with the same rules as hcapp_sendEventMessage: the effective preference (run bell when non-zero, else kennel bell), the 6-hour window for preference 4, HC6.RunChatTie for which runs buzz, one push per device token, retired / 180-day-idle devices and removed hashers skipped, and senders blocked by the recipient left out. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with the compound param string '<publicEventId>:<messageId>'; service accounts refused. There is NO check that the caller belongs to the kennel or may post in that run's chat. Who may post (2026-10-13): the sender must have a HasherKennelMap row for the run's kennel (removed = 0) or a HasherEventMap row on the run, as hcapp_sendEventMessage; otherwise {Success 0, 'Not authorised to post in this run''s chat'}.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: portal token whose param string is '<deviceSecret>:<publicEventId>:<messageId>', so a captured token cannot be replayed for another message.

parameters.name: publicEventId
parameters.description: Required: public event ID the message is associated with. Validated for NULL after auth check. Event must exist or SP returns 'Event not found'.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: Required: client-generated message ID. Used as the primary key for the EventMessage INSERT. Minted ONCE per message by the portal and resent unchanged on Retry: an id already stored for the same sender and run returns the stored message as success and pushes nobody (2026-10-14).

parameters.name: messageTitle
parameters.description: Optional title; defaults to the run's EventName.

parameters.name: messageContent
parameters.description: Message text, or the photo URL / map link for kinds 1 and 2. Required; at most 4000 characters (longer is refused, never truncated).
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(MAX) parameter vs EventMessage.MessageContent NVARCHAR(4000) (widened by db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-23_event_message_4000.sql; the table script still says 500). Deliberate: the SP refuses > 4000 with LEN() instead of truncating.

parameters.name: messageReleasabilityFlags
parameters.description: Audience bits: 0x01 mismanagement, 0x02 members, 0x04 followers, 0x08 RSVPs, 0x10 hares, 0x20 everyone. At least one of 0x3F is required.

parameters.name: messageKind
parameters.description: 0 text (default; NULL treated as 0), 1 photo, 2 location. Validated by HC6.ChatMessageKindError. Column added by db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-29_chat_kind_and_moderation.sql.

parameters.name: replyToMessageId
parameters.description: The message this one quotes; kept only when it belongs to the same run, otherwise silently dropped (the message is sent plain). Column added by db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-30_chat_replies_reactions.sql.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned instead of the data rowsets on auth failure, service-account caller, NULL publicEventId / messageId, empty content or no audience bit, content over 4000 characters, a bad photo/location (HC6.ChatMessageKindError), 'Event not found', or from the CATCH block (ROLLBACK, then HC.ErrorLog row, ERROR_MESSAGE()). A CATCH after rowsets were sent appends this envelope.

rowsets.name: MessageDetails
rowsets.description: Returned on success: one row, the created message with sender info (empty if the sender's account is removed). The MessageRelesabilityFlags column name has a typo — do not correct it, callers depend on it.

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: The SENDER's HC.Hasher.PublicHasherId (not the internal id, despite the name).

columns.name: UserDisplayName
columns.description: Hasher.DisplayName of the message sender (computed column)

columns.name: MessageContent
columns.description: HC6.ChatMessagePreview(MessageKind, MessageContent) — the push body, not the raw photo URL / map link.

columns.name: MessageRelesabilityFlags
columns.description: EventMessage.MessageReleasabilityFlags — note: column alias has a typo ('Releasability' misspelled)

rowsets.name: FullPushNotificationRecipients
rowsets.description: Visible push: kennel members/followers in the audience whose effective preference is 1, or 4 inside the 6-hour window, AND whose tie to the run is personal, GM/On-Sec, or a run-level bell. The sender is never included. DISTINCT per token.

columns.name: FcmToken
columns.description: Device.FcmToken — Firebase Cloud Messaging token (WHERE FcmToken IS NOT NULL ensures non-null, but declared nullable in Device table)

columns.name: BadgeTotal
columns.description: HC6.UserUnreadChatTotal for the recipient (aps.badge), only when a device with that token is on build >= HC6.MinBuildForIconBadge(); NULL otherwise.

rowsets.name: InAppOnlyNotificationRecipients
rowsets.description: Silent push (badge moves): audience members who do not buzz but have a run bell or a personal / kennel / GM-On-Sec tie, plus the sender's own devices (delivery echo). A token already in rowset 2 is not repeated.

columns.name: BadgeTotal
columns.description: HC6.UserUnreadChatTotal for the recipient (aps.badge), only when a device with that token is on build >= HC6.MinBuildForIconBadge(); NULL otherwise.

sideEffects: The API shim sends a visible push to rowset 2 tokens and a silent data push to rowset 3 tokens
Reads HC6.RunChatTie, HC6.UserUnreadChatTotal, HC6.ChatMessagePreview, HC6.ChatMessageKindError, HC6.MinBuildForIconBadge
On a runtime error: INSERT HC.ErrorLog after the ROLLBACK
Membership check reads HC.HasherKennelMap / HC.HasherEventMap before the insert.
A repeat @messageId (same sender and run) inserts nothing and returns empty recipient rowsets: no second push.

codeSmells.issue: Run start instant derived from raw EventStartDatetime
codeSmells.detail: Line 167 casts EventStartDatetime to DATETIME and applies the kennel city's timezone to get UTC for the 6-hour window; HC.Event.EventStartDateTimeGmt already holds the instant (see /hc-event-datetimes). A run whose own timezone differs from its kennel city's gets the window wrong.
Lines 163-172 resolve the event by PublicEventId without filtering deleted/removed, so a message can be posted to a run that no longer exists.

codeSmells.issue: Resolved 2026-09-25: push fan-out drift from hcapp_sendEventMessage
codeSmells.detail: Preference 0 counted as 'on' (whole-roster pushes), no DISTINCT on token, retired/idle devices and deleted hashers included, CATCH did not log. Now mirrors the app SP; CATCH rolls back then logs to HC.ErrorLog.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never correct the 'MessageRelesabilityFlags' column name typo — callers depend on it
Never change the releasability bit flag values (0x0001-0x0020) without updating all callers
Never change the notification preference codes (1=Always, 2=Off, 3=Muted, 4=On 6h before) without updating callers
Never change the 6-hour proximity threshold without coordinating with the API shim and portal
changes: 1.2.0 (2026-09-25): rowsets 1 and 2 keep their columns (UserId, DisplayName, FcmToken); the audience rules now match hcapp_sendEventMessage (pref IN (1,3,4), one push per token, retired/180-day-idle devices, deleted hashers and removed links skipped). The sender still gets the silent echo when following/member and not switched off.

2026-10-13 (contract sweep): MessageContent widened to NVARCHAR(4000); MessageKind moved to its real position (after MessageContent); DisplayName added to the two recipient rowsets; description now covers RunChatTie, blocking and the missing post gate.

1.6.0 (2026-10-14): IDEMPOTENT (Idempotent writes: creates a row; client mints the id once per message; idempotency audit P2). An @messageId already stored for the same sender and run, checked WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) inside the transaction, is a repeat: success, rowset 0 = the stored message (empty if it has since been deleted), rowsets 1 and 2 EMPTY so the shim pushes nothing. It used to fail on the primary key. The same id held by another sender or run is refused with the error envelope ("messageId is already in use"). Rowset shapes unchanged.
